visual_synopsis: An old woman (a male actor in a white wig, glasses and headscarf) sits on a folding chair on a country road under fruit trees when a white Pajero pulls up and a man in sunglasses and an olive shirt leans out the window and talks at her for most of the sketch. The action then moves to a nearby unfinished stone house where he and several black-suited bodyguards pile out of the SUV and a white Lada Niva and rush around, and it ends with the old woman leaping up and bolting, leaving her chair empty.
